references.text: The description of the table (הַשֻּׁלְחָן) that was to be made for the tabernacle, with all its utensils.
Instructions for making the lampstand (הַמְּנֹרָה) and its utensils for the tabernacle.
The description of the altar of incense (מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת) that was to be built for the tabernacle.
Bezalel made the table of showbread and all its utensils according to the instructions.
Bezalel made the lampstand and its utensils from pure gold.
Bezalel made the altar of incense from acacia wood.
The Lord commanded Moses to set up the table and the lampstand, and to place the altar of incense in the tabernacle.
Instructions on how the Levites were to cover the table, the lampstand, and the altar of incense when the camp was to break camp.
Hebrews mentions the lampstand and the table as part of the furnishings of the first tent under the old covenant.
This reference shows the theological circle from instruction to completion of the holy furnishings.
Connects the building instructions with the actual service by showing the Levites' responsibility for the same holy objects.
